about: The Revenant Caves (Wilderness step W5.2): the 30 revenants (step W5.2) and the Emblem Trader (step W5.3) where the OSRS Wiki's locations maps pin them (read 2026-11-15), as many of each as the Wiki's Revenant Caves page counts; mejrs's NPCList_OSRS has only some. Their wander ranges are guessed until recorded.
